common.guideManipulationAdd: Select a shape type (ex: circle, arrow, rectangle) from the top toolbar, then click or drag on the screen to create an object. With the free drawing tool, you can draw directly by clicking and moving the mouse.
common.guideManipulationEdit: Click on an object to select it for editing. You can drag, resize with the mouse, or change its properties displayed in the right-hand toolbar.
common.guideManipulationGroup: Hold down the Ctrl key and click to select multiple objects you want to group. Then click the group button on the toolbar.
common.guideSave: Use the Import/Export function to save drawings in various formats or reopen saved drawings from your device or the cloud.
common.guideTemplate: You can save one or multiple objects as a template/component for reuse in other drawings.
common.aboutIntroduction: This is an intuitive tool that helps users create, edit, and manage content quickly and efficiently. With a user-friendly interface, the tool allows direct interaction on the screen, making it easy to draw basic shapes, perform freehand drawing, insert images, add text, use icons, or insert videos.
common.aboutFeatureObjectBasic: Line, arrow, circle, rectangle, convex polygon, concave polygon, ring, sector, quadratic and bezier curve.
common.aboutFeatureObjectText: Add text blocks for descriptions, annotations, or titles within the drawing.
common.aboutFeatureObjectImage: Insert images from your device or via links to illustrate or enhance visual content.
common.aboutFeatureObjectIcon: A library with over 3000 diverse icons that can be used to highlight or complement your drawings.
common.aboutFeatureObjectVideo: Insert videos from your device or via links to enhance visualization and interactivity.
common.aboutFeatureObjectMultiLine: Allows drawing multi lines on the screen.
common.aboutFeatureObjectFreeDrawing: Allows drawing freely on the screen, suitable for sketching or quick creative work.
common.aboutFeatureManipulationAdd: Add new objects by clicking or dragging and dropping them directly into the workspace.
common.aboutFeatureManipulationEdit: Supports editing actions: dragging, resizing one or multiple objects at once, and modifying object details.
common.aboutFeatureTemplate: Allows saving objects or drawings as templates/components for reuse.
common.aboutFeatureIO: Supports importing/exporting data from/to devices and cloud in multiple formats for sharing or storage.
common.aboutFeatureShortcut: A system of shortcuts that enables faster operations, saving time for professional users.
common.aboutFeatureHistory: Automatically saves operation history, allowing you to undo or redo when necessary.
common.aboutFeatureOther: Changing background color, displaying alignment guides, toggling grid, and many other useful features.
common.aboutLicense: This product is developed and copyrighted by Viettel HighTech.
